svg.aria-label: Feed retrieval in detail: the user's GET goes through a load balancer and web servers to the news feed service, which 1 looks up the feed's post IDs in the news feed cache, 2 hydrates them with full user objects (names, profile pictures) and post objects (text, image links) from the user and post caches, and 3 returns the hydrated feed as JSON. Images and videos are loaded from a CDN.
svg.title: Feed retrieval
